name: ExpandOrCollapseUIElement
label: Expand or Collapse UI Element
description: Expands or collapses a UI element (such as a tree item or combo box) by searching for it using a property and value.

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: UI Element
fields.description: The UI element which you would like to expand or collapse.

fields.name: ActionType
fields.label: Action Type
fields.description: Choose whether to expand or collapse the element.

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait to find the UI element (in seconds).

fields.name: WasSuccessful
fields.label: Was Successful
fields.description: True if the element was expanded or collapsed successfully, otherwise false.
